name: Cheese and Onion Pie

ingredients.name: vegetarian mature cheddar-style cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Rub the cold butter into the flour until coarse crumbs form. Stir in 4 g salt and add cold water gradually, mixing just until the dough comes together. Divide about two-thirds for the base and one-third for the lid. Flatten, wrap and chill both pieces for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile heat the neutral oil in a wide pan over medium-low heat. Cook the thinly sliced onions with the remaining 3 g salt for 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until soft, sweet and most moisture has evaporated. Stir in mustard, thyme and black pepper, then cool completely. Check the cheese label to ensure it contains no animal-derived coagulants.

Heat the oven to 200°C. Roll the larger chilled dough piece into a round big enough to line a 22 cm pie dish with overhang. Press it gently into the dish. Spread half the cooled onions in the base, add half the grated vegetarian cheese, then repeat the onion and cheese layers. Keep the filling below the rim.

Roll the smaller dough piece into a lid. Brush the exposed base edge with a little milk, place the lid on top, press to seal and crimp around the rim. Cut two small steam vents and brush the lid with the remaining milk for an eggless golden finish. Chill for 10 minutes if the pastry has softened.

Bake for 35–40 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and crisp and the cheese bubbles at the vents. Rest for at least 15 minutes before cutting into four wedges, so the soft onion-cheese filling holds its shape. Serve warm with a simple salad.
tips: Cool the onions fully before they touch the pastry; hot or watery onion makes a soggy base. Use cheese explicitly made with vegetarian or microbial rennet. The reviewed photo shows a round lidded pie and a cut wedge filled mainly with tender onion and melted pale cheese, without potato.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
